claims: According to reports from WrestleMania 42 on April 19, 2026, Brock Lesnar has seemingly retired from WWE after a loss to Oba Femi.
Brock Lesnar lost to Oba Femi at WrestleMania 42 Night Two in Las Vegas.
Brock Lesnar lost to Oba Femi in less than five minutes.
Following the match, Brock Lesnar left his gloves and boots in the center of the ring.
Leaving gloves and boots in the center of the ring is a traditional sign of retirement in professional wrestling.
Brock Lesnar left his gear in the ring.
Brock Lesnar hugged his manager, Paul Heyman.
Brock Lesnar indicated he was "done" with wrestling in 2020.
Brock Lesnar returned to wrestling in 2021.
Multiple sources currently treat Brock Lesnar's gesture as the conclusion of his career.
Wikipedia reflects Brock Lesnar's retirement in 2026.
